arms.B2: A1 initial judgement followed by complete-condition semantic review

reuse: Reuse original A1 dev96, historical192, new72 predictions, including as B2 first pass; do not repeat A0, A2, Qwen or historical A1 inference.
natural72: 72 new synthetic natural-language cases, 12 themes, 24 counterfactual pairs and 24 missing-information cases; frozen before prediction
metrics: calls tokens actual GPU generation time
cost: Report full two-pass logical cost separately from newly executed cost; amortized batch time is not online latency.
model: original Phi-4 plus TrialMatchAI LoRA, original NF4 quantization, batch8 greedy max384 tokens per pass
scope: Synthetic fictional routing experiment, not clinical validation. Historical192 and prior new72 are regression comparisons.
